title: Rubber Hose
look: A 1930s cartoon: sepia, a fat black line, film grain, on twos.

doc.essence: An early sound cartoon: sepia stock, fat black line, flickering projector, animated on twos.
doc.notIt: Not ink (sepia, grain, flicker, on twos).
doc.shapes: Fat black outline. Big round shapes, noodle arms that bend in one curve with no elbow, white four-finger gloves, big shoes.
doc.eyes: Pie eyes: tall white ovals with black pupils that have a wedge cut out. A wide grin.
doc.motion: On twos with a faint projector flicker, and a constant bounce on the beat.
